text: SELECT customers.customer_id, customers.customer_name, SUM(order_items.product_price) AS revenue FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS order_items JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" AS orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers" AS customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id GROUP BY customers.customer_id, customers.customer_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
